sources.population: Terrestrial critically ill patients, Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (Boston); derived from the MIMIC II matched waveform database; 53 recordings of ~8 min
citations: PhysioNet BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset v1.0.0. DOI 10.13026/C2208R.
Pimentel MAF et al. Towards a Robust Estimation of Respiratory Rate from Pulse Oximeters. IEEE Trans Biomed Eng. 2016;64(8):1914-1923. DOI 10.1109/TBME.2016.2613124.
Pollard T, Moody BE, Lehman L, Gow B, Fernandes C, Xie C, Johnson A, Mark RG, Heldt T. PhysioNet as a global platform for biomedical research. Nature Health (2026). DOI 10.1038/s44360-026-00096-z.
sources.use: Processed subset in data/processed/bidmc_subset/. Never loaded into astronaut routes and never relabeled as astronaut data.
